source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseDmlIdAccessLevelEvidenceTest { private static Id accountId(String name) { Account row = new Account(Name = name); insert row; return row.Id; } @isTest static void idRows() { Id a = accountId('A'); Database.DeleteResult d1 = Database.delete(a); System.assert(d1.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u1 = Database.undelete(a); System.assert(u1.isSuccess()); Id b = accountId('B'); Database.DeleteResult d2 = Database.delete(b, false); System.assert(d2.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u2 = Database.undelete(b, false); System.assert(u2.isSuccess()); Id c = accountId('C'); Database.DeleteResult d3 = Database.delete(c, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(d3.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u3 = Database.undelete(c, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(u3.isSuccess()); Id d = accountId('D'); Database.DeleteResult d4 = Database.delete(d, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(d4.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u4 = Database.undelete(d, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(u4.isSuccess()); Id e = accountId('E'); Id f = accountId('F'); List<Database.DeleteResult> listDeleted = Database.delete(new List<Id>{e, f}); System.assertEquals(2, listDeleted.size()); System.assert(listDeleted[0].isSuccess()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> listUndeleted = Database.undelete(new List<Id>{e, f}); System.assertEquals(2, listUndeleted.size()); System.assert(listUndeleted[1].isSuccess()); Id g = accountId('G'); Id h = accountId('H'); List<Database.DeleteResult> listDeletedAll = Database.delete(new List<Id>{g, h}, false); System.assertEquals(2, listDeletedAll.size()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> listUndeletedAll = Database.undelete(new List<Id>{g, h}, false); System.assertEquals(2, listUndeletedAll.size()); Id i = accountId('I'); Id j = accountId('J'); List<Database.DeleteResult> listDeletedAccess = Database.delete(new List<Id>{i, j}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listDeletedAccess.size()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> listUndeletedAccess = Database.undelete(new List<Id>{i, j}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listUndeletedAccess.size()); Id k = accountId('K'); Id l = accountId('L'); List<Database.DeleteResult> listDeletedBoth = Database.delete(new List<Id>{k, l}, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listDeletedBoth.size()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> listUndeletedBoth = Database.undelete(new List<Id>{k, l}, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listUndeletedBoth.size()); Id purgeOne = accountId('Purge One'); System.assert(Database.delete(purgeOne, false).isSuccess()); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult purged = Database.emptyRecycleBin(purgeOne); System.assert(purged.isSuccess()); Id purgeTwo = accountId('Purge Two'); Id purgeThree = accountId('Purge Three'); System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(new List<Id>{purgeTwo, purgeThree}, false).size()); List<Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult> purgedList = Database.emptyRecycleBin(new List<Id>{purgeTwo, purgeThree}); System.assertEquals(2, purgedList.size()); System.assert(purgedList[0].isSuccess()); } }
